steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: What are the results?

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Both Sinners had high M values which increased significantly when they use their abilities, but now...

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: Incredible. They are already back to the normal level.

steps.speaker: Anne
steps.content: ...Iron, is this true? Has the Mania actually gone down? Can this person's shackles really control Mania?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I'll find out.

steps.speaker: SALVA Nurse
steps.content: Dr. Iron! Th-the isolation ward!
Iron stands up with a serious but unsurprised look as she pushes the hospital bed with you lying paralyzed on it.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Let's go. Come to the emergency surgery with me. I need your ability.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: The hospital underground hides countless corpses of dead soldiers and shady experiments. The medical director, Iron, is crazy about some forbidden surgeries to distort the patients' minds.
Is the so-called emergency surgery the forbidden surgery mentioned by Ted?

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Heh... Surgery to save a patient.
She sneers as if she knows what you were thinking, then drags your hospital bed forward.

After passing through the wards and entering the basement, a heavy door is pushed open. The painful, hysterical groans, the foul odor, and the smell of disinfectant in the isolation ward instantly overwhelm your senses.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Are all the patients with symptoms here?

steps.speaker: SALVA Nurse
steps.content: Yes. No.728 is close to the threshold.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Okay. Secure the isolation ward and make sure it's soundproof. Don't let anyone come near.
The door slams shut with a thud. Iron puts on a mask and quickly sterilizes her prostheses, then she nods at you—Now you can move.
It was a small hidden room about 80 square feet big. Dozens of gangsters are lying down twistedly—They are mostly Ted's subordinates.
They are strapped to the hospital bed. Under the influence of Mania, they are laughing and howling monstrously and struggling until their bodies become a bloody mess.
Iron! The SALVA witch! Hand over your men and inheritance, or the boss is gonna kill you!
I'll crash your crappy hospital and kill all your pretentious bastard doctors, and you and that Sinner nurse too—Mmm—Mmmmmm!!!
Iron slaps the gangster on the face and seals his mouth. At this point, the doctors' glares were sharper and colder than a scalpel.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Shut up, loser. The operating table isn't a place for you to go nuts.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I'll be in charge of the operation. Everyone, follow my command.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: I'll tamper with 728's nerves and delay the spread of Mania, while you use the shackles on 728, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Sinners, get ready for a fight. All of those isolated here are Maniacs. They could go manic and attack us any time.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You want to save your enemies?

steps.content: Ted said that SALVA is brainwashing the Syndicans with Mania and an enemy of all the gangs.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: As a doctor, disease and death are my only enemies.
Ted says SALVA is using and after Mania.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Mania distorts humans, while doctors help to restore their sanity. This is my duty.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Once a person is infested by Mania, the mutation will only ever worsen and eventually turn them into Corruptors. But you are an exception.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Those Sinners controlled by your shackles have very stable M values. Their Mania is suppressed completely.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: And you have experienced so many outbreaks of Mania yet still haven't been infected—You are the key to healing Mania.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Okay. Let's start the operation.

steps.speaker: Iron
steps.content: Sinners, be on your guard. Protect your chief!
